lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A 2D grid of high-luminance, approximately circular white spots arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows. The centroids are most distinct and widely spaced on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed clusters toward the cranial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a consistent grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs longitudinally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a pronounced shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A clear spatial transition in spot morphology is present, where fine-grained, high-density spotting on the cranial region shifts to larger, more sparse, and grid-aligned spotting on the lateral flank.
